'''Calliandro's''' was a restaurant located in [[Equator City/Legends|Equator City]] on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], in the same entertainment complex as the [[Flip of the Credit]] Casino. It was known for its excellent [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] cuisine.
